notes.title: Tyrant Quest: Gold Edition - Minor bugfixes
notes.notes:
We just rolled a small patch, that fixes some minor issues.

Changelog:
- Fixed Seren scene 3 not being shown as unlocked in the scoreboard of Chapter 5, despites unlocking it.
- Fixed Elanor scene 3 in the replay gallery which was not replayable in some situations despites unlocking it.
- Corrected two mistakes in the walkthrough/guide.
